{{Quote|At the time the Ukatis system was interdicted by its own King. He preferred to keep his people starving and poor, all the better to oppress them.|Jolee Bindo|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
The '''Ukatis system''' was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and contained the celestial body [[Ukatis]]. By [[3996 BBY]], the [[Star system/Legends|star system's]] [[Unidentified Ukatis system king|king]] ordered its [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]], which resulted in its inhabitants suffering from [[Diet/Legends|starvation]]. Subsequently, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Jolee Bindo]] and a [[Jolee Bindo's smuggling partner|partner]] began [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and supplies through the blockade. The [[Ukatis enforcer]] [[Nayama]], however, at one point shot down Bindo's [[Starship/Legends|starship]], which led to the Jedi being [[Prisoner/Legends|incarcerated]] at a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on Ukatis. After he was ultimately broken out of prison, both he and Nayama eventually left the Ukatis system.

==Description==
The Ukatis system was a part of the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the terrestrial celestial body [[Ukatis]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Senate was trying to negotiate a peace, but they were getting nowhere as usual. I decided I wasn't going to wait. I found myself a ship and a partner and we began smuggling food and supplies to the Ukatis citizenry through the blockade.|Jolee Bindo|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
[[File:UkatisJediCivilWar-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|290px|By 3959 BBY, the Ukatis system was situated in the area widely explored by the Galactic Republic.]]
At some point by [[3996 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' establishes that [[Jolee Bindo]]'s [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was shot down over [[Ukatis]] at some point before the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to [[3996 BBY]].</ref> the [[Unidentified Ukatis system king|king]] of the Ukatis [[Star system/Legends|system]] ordered its [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] in order to oppress the local citizens, who consequently suffered from [[Diet/Legends|starvation]]. The [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] attempted to negotiate a peace; however, those efforts were unsuccessful. Eventually, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Jolee Bindo]], after acquiring a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and a [[Jolee Bindo's smuggling partner|partner]], began [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and supplies through the blockade. Relying on his [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] skills as well as the use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Bindo and his partner successfully navigated difficult situations against staggering odds, never getting caught in their endeavors.<ref name="KOTOR" />

At one point, however, the [[Ukatis enforcer]] [[Nayama]], operating aboard a lone Ukatish [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], shot down Bindo's craft, forcing it to crash-land on Ukatis. The enforcer then dragged the Padawan to the local [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], where he was [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]]. Ultimately, Bindo was broken out of the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] and kidnapped Nayama, and at some point thereafter, the pair fell in love and [[Marriage/Legends|married]], and eventually left the Ukatis system.<ref name="KOTOR" /> By [[3959 BBY]], the system fell within the "civilized [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]," the territory that had been widely [[Scout/Legends|explored]] by the Republic.<ref name="TEA" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic}}
In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="3956 BBY">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' to [[3956 BBY]].</ref> Bindo told the Jedi trainee [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] about his adventures in the Ukatis system.<ref name="KOTOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Inhabitants==
The Ukatis system was governed by a [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]] that was headed by a [[King/Legends|king]]. Its population numbered at least several million.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ukatis system was introduced in the [[2003]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''. In the game, the [[Star/Legends|star]] system can be mentioned in an optional conversation the player character, Revan, can have with Jolee Bindo. This article assumes one hundred percent game completion and that the conversation took place as described.<ref name="KOTOR" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square L-15.<ref name="TEA" />
